5	/-
6	  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
7	  The meaning of a formula over a trace: one three-valued result with reasons per instant.
8	
9	  `evalAll` evaluates a formula bottom-up, each subformula once for the whole trace, so a formula
10	  costs O(|φ| · n log n) per binding: atoms map a scene function over the instants, the temporal
11	  operators are the single-pass operators of Temporal.lean, quantifiers evaluate their body once
12	  per region or device present anywhere in the trace. `eval c i φ` is the value at instant i.
13	
14	  Atoms and derived concepts are dispatched by name to the definitions of Atoms.lean and
15	  Primitives.lean; a name the tables do not know, a wrong arity, a literal that spells no
16	  enumeration value or a variable of the wrong sort is `unknown (malformed …)`. The static check
17	  (RuleEval.check) finds every such defect from the syntax before any trace is read, so a checked
18	  rule reports at evaluation time only source absence, truncation, sampling gaps, undefined
19	  concept preconditions, division by zero and unknown compositions.
20	
21	  Finite-trace policy — unobserved is unknown, never compliance:
22	  - `holdsFor` needs its whole window observed at adequate density, else unknown;
23	  - `within`/`untilWithin` are true on a witness, false only when the window is covered;
24	  - `eventually`/`until` carry the unobserved future, `since` the unobserved past, and `always`
25	    the unobserved future as unknown: on a finite trace `always φ` is false or unknown, never true.
26	    A rule's obligation is written for an instant; the sweep over instants (Grounding) is the
27	    "always".
28	
29	  Rule composition is a callback, because the library of rules is defined above this file.
30	-/

41	/-- Everything an evaluation needs: the indexed trace with its reading, the bindings, and how to
42	    evaluate another rule's obligation (`rule id map`) under a variable map, per instant. -/
43	structure SemCtx where
44	  d : Primitives.Ctx
45	  β : Binding := {}
46	  /-- Another rule's verdict per instant under a variable map: complied-with when `engaged` is
47	      false, engaged (classes and applicability) when true. -/
48	  compose : String → List (String × String) → Binding → Bool → Array R :=
49	    fun _ _ _ _ => #[]

51	namespace SemCtx
52	def n (c : SemCtx) : Nat := c.d.n
53	def scenes (c : SemCtx) : Array Scene := c.d.scenes
54	def bindVar (c : SemCtx) (v : String) (x : Val) : SemCtx := { c with β := c.β.bind v x }
55	def mk' (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (β : Binding := {}) : SemCtx := { d := Primitives.Ctx.mk' τ ρ, β := β }
56	end SemCtx

61	def resolve (β : Binding) : Arg → Except UnknownReason DArg
62	  | .var v =>
63	    match β.lookup v with
64	    | some (.track t) => .ok (.v t)
65	    | some (.region r) => .ok (.v r)
66	    | some (.device d) => .ok (.v d)
67	    | none => .error (.unboundVariable v)
68	  | .lit s => .ok (.s s)
69	  | .nat k => .ok (.n k)
70	
71	def resolveAll (β : Binding) (args : List Arg) : Except UnknownReason (List DArg) := args.mapM (resolve β)
72	
73	private def ent (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason Nat :=
74	  match a with | .v t => .ok t | .n k => .ok k | .s _ => .error (.malformed "entity expected")
75	private def lit (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason String :=
76	  match a with | .s s => .ok s | _ => .error (.malformed "literal expected")
77	private def enumLit {α : Type} (ofString : String → Option α) (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason α := do
78	  let s ← lit a
79	  match ofString s with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.malformed s)
80	
81	private def b (o : Option Bool) (name : String) : R := R.ofOption o (.absentAtom name)
82	private def eqEnum {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (o : Option α) (v : α) (name : String) : R :=
83	  b (o.map (· == v)) name
84	private def q (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=
85	  match o with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
86	private def qn (o : Option Nat) (name : String) : QR :=
87	  match o with | some v => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat v)) | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
88	private def qz (o : Option Int) (name : String) : QR :=
89	  match o with | some v => .ok (Q.ofInt v) | none => .error (.absentAtom name)

91	def unknownAtom (n : String) : UnknownReason := .malformed s!"atom {n}"
92	def arity (n : String) : UnknownReason := .malformed s!"arity {n}"

260	-- Measured atoms by name (quantity-valued), on one scene. Vector atoms take a component literal.
261	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
262	private def comp (v : Option Vec) (k : DArg) (name : String) : QR := do
263	  match k with
264	  | .s "x" => q (v.map (·.1)) name
265	  | .s "y" => q (v.map (·.2)) name
266	  | _ => .error (.malformed "component")

268	def evalMeasure (s : Scene) (name : String) (args : List DArg) : QR := do
269	  match name, args with
270	  | "kin_time", [] => .ok (Time.ofTimestamp (kin_time s))
271	  | "kin_position", [x, k] => comp (kin_position s (← ent x)) k name
272	  | "kin_heading", [x, k] => comp ((kin_heading s (← ent x)).bind Geom.unit) k name
273	  | "kin_velocity", [x, k] => comp (kin_velocity s (← ent x)) k name
274	  | "kin_speed", [x] => q (kin_speed s (← ent x)) name
275	  | "kin_accel_longitudinal", [x] => q (kin_accel_longitudinal s (← ent x)) name
276	  | "kin_yaw_rate", [x] => q (kin_yaw_rate s (← ent x)) name
277	  | "kin_extent", [x, k] =>
278	    let e := kin_extent s (← ent x)
279	    match k with   -- full extents: twice the half-extent
280	    | .s "length" => q (e.map fun (l, _, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) l) name

340	/-- Whether a name is known to either table (the doctor holds this against `atomIds`). -/
341	def knowsAtom (n : String) : Bool :=
342	  let s : Scene := { t := 0 }
343	  let isUnknown : Except UnknownReason R → Bool
344	    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
345	    | _ => false
346	  let isUnknownQ : QR → Bool
347	    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
348	    | _ => false
349	  !(isUnknown (evalAtomE s n [] []) && isUnknownQ (evalMeasure s n []))

351	/-- The sort each entity argument of an atom must have (`none` marks a literal position): by
352	    family, with the mixed atoms listed. `none` for a name the tables do not know. -/
353	def atomArgSorts (name : String) : Option (List (Option EntityKind)) :=
354	  let t := some EntityKind.track; let r := some EntityKind.region; let d := some EntityKind.device
355	  match name with
356	  | "rel_occupies" => some [t, r]
357	  | "ru_aggregate" => some [t, none]
358	  | "dev_governs" => some [d, r]
359	  | "st_region_geometry_distance" | "st_sight_along_way" => some [t, r]
360	  | "st_lane_adjacency" => some [r, none, r]
361	  | "st_lane_adjacency_left" | "st_lane_adjacency_right" | "st_lane_connectivity" | "st_lane_enters" | "st_on_way"
362	  | "st_entrance_of" => some [r, r]
363	  | "st_lane_marking" => some [r, none, none, none]
364	  | "rel_oncoming" | "rel_same_direction" | "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" | "rel_ahead_in_lane"
365	  | "rel_behind_in_lane" | "rel_contact" | "rel_visible" | "rel_centre_distance" | "rel_longitudinal_overlap" => some [t, t]
366	  | "rel_surface_gap" | "rel_bearing" => some [t, t, none]
367	  | n =>
368	    if !knowsAtom n then none
369	    else if n.startsWith "env_" || n == "kin_time" then some []
370	    else if n.startsWith "ru_" || n.startsWith "kin_" || n.startsWith "sig_" then some [t, none, none]
371	    else if n.startsWith "st_" then some [r, none, none]
372	    else if n.startsWith "dev_" then some [d, none, none]

381	def constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array R := const n (R.u w)
382	def constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array QR := Array.replicate n (.error w)
383	def liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R)) : Array R :=
384	  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constU n w
385	def liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR)) : Array QR :=
386	  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constE n w
387	def qzip (f : Q → Q → Q) (a b : Array QR) : Array QR :=
388	  Array.zipWith (fun x y => do pure (f (← x) (← y))) a b

390	/-- A term that names no instant: a literal, a parameter or arithmetic over those. Only such a
391	    term may parametrize an atom or a derived concept. -/
392	partial def Term.isConstant : Term → Bool
393	  | .lit _ _ | .param _ => true
394	  | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => Term.isConstant a && Term.isConstant b
395	  | .neg a | .abs a => Term.isConstant a
396	  | _ => false

401	  arr[0]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)

446	/-- φ where the precondition holds; undefined where it is false; the precondition's reasons where
447	    it is unknown. -/
448	def definedWhenR (pre x : R) : R :=
449	  match pre.v with
450	  | .t => x
451	  | .f => R.u (.undefined "defined_when")
452	  | .u => ⟨.u, pre.why⟩

454	/-- A selection at one instant: the branch the guard picks; where the guard is unknown, the
455	    branches' common value, else unknown with the guard's reasons. -/
456	def condAt (g : R) (a b : QR) : QR :=
457	  match g.v with
458	  | .t => a
459	  | .f => b
460	  | .u => match a, b with
461	    | .ok x, .ok y => if Q.eq x y then .ok x else .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))
462	    | _, _ => .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))

464	/-- An aggregate over the members present at one instant: unknown when a member's membership is
465	    unknown or a member's value is; `count` on an empty set is zero, the others are undefined. -/
466	def aggregateAt (op : AggOp) (xs : List (R × QR)) : QR :=
467	  match xs.find? (fun (f, _) => f.v == .u) with
468	  | some (f, _) => .error (f.why.head?.getD (.malformed "aggregate"))
469	  | none =>
470	    let vals := xs.filterMap fun (f, q) => if f.v == .t then some q else none
471	    match op with
472	    | .count => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat vals.length))
473	    | _ => do
474	      let qs ← vals.mapM fun q => q
475	      if qs.isEmpty then .error (.undefined "aggregate")
476	      else
477	        let sorted := qs.toArray.qsort (fun a b => Q.lt a b)
478	        match op with
479	        | .min => .ok sorted[0]!
480	        | .max => .ok sorted[sorted.size - 1]!
481	        | _ => .ok sorted[sorted.size / 2]!

483	/-- Membership of a road user in a legal aggregate at one scene: true when it carries an included
484	    class; unknown, with the observation's reason, when an included or unresolved class it might
485	    carry is unobserved; unknown as `aggregateUnresolved` when it carries a class the definition
486	    leaves unresolved; false otherwise. -/
487	def aggregateMembership (s : Scene) (t : TrackId) (a : LegalAggregate) : R :=
488	  let classes := fun (ids : List String) => ids.filterMap fun i => RoadUserClass.ofString (i.drop 3).toString
489	  match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.included) with
490	  | some true => R.t
491	  | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")
492	  | some false =>
493	    match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.unresolved) with
494	    | some true => R.u (.aggregateUnresolved a.id)
495	    | some false => R.f
496	    | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")

498	/-- Kleene aggregate at each instant over the evaluated members present in that scene. -/
499	def perScene (c : SemCtx) (evaluated : List (Nat × Array R))
500	    (presentIn : Scene → Nat → Bool) (agg : List R → R) : Array R :=
501	  (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
502	    let s := c.scenes[i]!
503	    agg (evaluated.filterMap fun (m, arr) => if presentIn s m then some arr[i]! else none)

505	mutual
506	  def evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : Term → Array QR
507	    | .lit v _ => Array.replicate c.n (.ok v)
508	    | .param p => Array.replicate c.n (match c.d.ρ.param p with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.parameterMissing p))
509	    | .measure a args =>
510	      match resolveAll c.β args with
511	      | .error w => constE c.n w
512	      | .ok ds => c.scenes.map fun s => evalMeasure s a ds
513	    | .quantity concept args ps =>
514	      liftQ c.n do
515	        let vs ← constParams c ps
516	        Primitives.evalQ concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
517	    | .distanceWhile subj φ =>
518	      match c.β.track subj with
519	      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
520	      | some x => Primitives.distanceWhile c.d x (evalAll c φ)
521	    | .sinceRise φ => sinceRiseAll c.d.times (evalAll c φ)
522	    | .headingSince subj g ψ =>
523	      match c.β.track subj with
524	      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
525	      | some x => liftQ c.n do
526	          let gv ← stepOf g (evalTAll c g)
527	          pure (Primitives.headingSince c.d x gv (evalAll c ψ))
528	    | .aggregate op v φ t =>
529	      let members := (usersOf c).map fun u =>
530	        let c' := c.bindVar v (.track u)
531	        (u, evalAll c' φ, evalTAll c' t)
532	      (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
533	        let s := c.scenes[i]!
534	        aggregateAt op (members.filterMap fun (u, fa, ta) => if s.tracks.contains u then some (fa[i]!, ta[i]!) else none)
535	    | .add a b' => qzip Q.add (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
536	    | .sub a b' => qzip Q.sub (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
537	    | .mul a b' => qzip Q.mul (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
538	    | .div a b' => Array.zipWith (fun x y => do
539	        let d ← y
540	        if Q.isZero d then .error (.divisionByZero "div") else pure (Q.div (← x) d)) (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
541	    | .neg a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.neg)
542	    | .abs a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.abs)
543	    | .cond φ a b' =>
544	      let g := evalAll c φ; let x := evalTAll c a; let y := evalTAll c b'
545	      (Array.range c.n).map fun i => condAt (g[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)) (x[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)) (y[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange))
546	  termination_by t => sizeOf t

548	  /-- Parameters of an atom or derived concept: constant terms, evaluated once. -/
549	  def constParams (c : SemCtx) : List Term → Except UnknownReason (List Q)
550	    | [] => .ok []
551	    | t :: rest => do
552	      let v ← constOf t (evalTAll c t)
553	      pure (v :: (← constParams c rest))
554	  termination_by ts => sizeOf ts

556	  def evalAll (c : SemCtx) : Formula → Array R
557	    | .tt => const c.n R.t
558	    | .ff => const c.n R.f
559	    | .atom name args ps =>
560	      liftA c.n do
561	        let vs ← constParams c ps
562	        let ds ← resolveAll c.β args
563	        if name == "ru_aggregate" then
564	          pure (match ds with
565	            | [.v t, .s id] =>
566	              match c.d.aggregateOverrides.find? (fun (x, a, _) => x == t && a == id) with
567	              | some (_, _, v) => const c.n (R.ofBool v)
568	              | none =>
569	                match c.d.ρ.aggregate id with
570	                | none => const c.n (R.u (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{id}"))
571	                | some a => c.scenes.map fun s => aggregateMembership s t a
572	            | _ => const c.n (R.u (.malformed "aggregate arguments")))
573	        else pure (c.scenes.map fun s => match evalAtomE s name ds vs with | .ok r => r | .error w => R.u w)
574	    | .cmp l op r => Array.zipWith (fun x y => match x, y with
575	        | .ok a, .ok b => R.ofBool (op.apply a b)
576	        | .error w, _ | _, .error w => R.u w) (evalTAll c l) (evalTAll c r)
577	    | .asm id => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.assumption id) (.assumptionMissing id)
578	    | .intent id who target =>
579	      match who, target with
580	      | .var a, .var b =>
581	        match c.β.lookup a, c.β.lookup b with
582	        | some (.track x), some (.region r) => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.intention id x r) (.intentionMissing id)
583	        | none, _ => constU c.n (.unboundVariable a)
584	        | _, none => constU c.n (.unboundVariable b)
585	        | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
586	      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
587	    | .same a b =>
588	      match resolve c.β a, resolve c.β b with
589	      | .ok (.v i), .ok (.v j) => const c.n (R.ofBool (i == j))
590	      | .error w, _ | _, .error w => constU c.n w
591	      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "same: entities expected")
592	    | .not φ => mapNot (evalAll c φ)
593	    -- a connective whose left operand settles it at every instant does not evaluate its right one
594	    | .and φ ψ =>
595	      let a := evalAll c φ
596	      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.f) else zipAnd a (evalAll c ψ)
597	    | .or φ ψ =>
598	      let a := evalAll c φ
599	      if a.all (·.v == .t) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipOr a (evalAll c ψ)
600	    | .implies φ ψ =>
601	      let a := evalAll c φ
602	      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipImplies a (evalAll c ψ)
603	    | .always φ => alwaysAll (evalAll c φ)
604	    | .eventually φ => eventuallyAll (evalAll c φ)
605	    | .until φ ψ => untilAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
606	    | .since φ ψ => sinceAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
607	    | .holdsFor m d subj φ =>
608	      liftA c.n do
609	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
610	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
611	        pure (holdsForAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "holdsFor" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
612	    | .within m d subj φ =>
613	      liftA c.n do
614	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
615	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
616	        pure (withinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "within" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
617	    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
618	      liftA c.n do
619	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
620	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
621	        pure (untilWithinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "untilWithin" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ))
622	    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
623	      liftA c.n do
624	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
625	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
626	        pure (atLastAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "atLast" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c ψ) (evalAll c φ))
627	    | .count edge sinceφ op k =>
628	      (countEdgesAll "count" (evalAll c edge) (evalAll c sinceφ)).map fun e => match e with
629	        | .error w => R.u w
630	        | .ok m => R.ofBool (op.apply (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat m)) (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)))
631	    | .rises φ => risesAll (evalAll c φ)
632	    | .definedWhen pre φ => Array.zipWith definedWhenR (evalAll c pre) (evalAll c φ)
633	    | .derived concept args ps =>
634	      liftA c.n do
635	        let vs ← constParams c ps
636	        Primitives.evalB concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
637	    | .rule id map =>
638	      let arr := c.compose id map c.β false
639	      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
640	    | .ruleApplies id map =>
641	      let arr := c.compose id map c.β true
642	      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
643	    | .existsUser v φ =>
644	      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
645	        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.any
646	    | .forallUser v φ =>
647	      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
648	        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.all
649	    | .existsRegion k v φ =>
650	      match regionKindOf k with
651	      | .error w => constU c.n w
652	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
653	            (r, Array.zipWith R.and (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
654	          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.any
655	    | .forallRegion k v φ =>
656	      match regionKindOf k with
657	      | .error w => constU c.n w
658	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
659	            (r, Array.zipWith R.implies (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
660	          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.all
661	    | .existsDevice k v φ =>
662	      match deviceKindOf k with
663	      | .error w => constU c.n w
664	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
665	            (d, Array.zipWith R.and (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
666	          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.any
667	    | .forallDevice k v φ =>
668	      match deviceKindOf k with
669	      | .error w => constU c.n w
670	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
671	            (d, Array.zipWith R.implies (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
672	          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.all
673	  termination_by φ => sizeOf φ
674	end
675	
676	/-- The value of a formula at instant `i`. -/
677	def eval (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : R := (evalAll c φ)[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)
678	def evalTri (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : Tri := (eval c i φ).v

681	-- Lengths: every formula and every term has exactly one value per observation of the trace.
682	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
683	section Lengths
684	
685	private theorem n_bindVar (c : SemCtx) (v : String) (x : Val) : (c.bindVar v x).n = c.n := rfl
686	private theorem size_constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : (constU n w).size = n := by
687	  simp [constU, Temporal.size_const]
688	private theorem size_constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : (constE n w).size = n := by simp [constE]
689	private theorem size_liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R))
690	    (h : ∀ a, e = .ok a → a.size = n) : (liftA n e).size = n := by
691	  unfold liftA; cases e with
692	  | ok a => exact h a rfl
693	  | error w => exact size_constU n w
694	private theorem size_liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR))
695	    (h : ∀ a, e = .ok a → a.size = n) : (liftQ n e).size = n := by

697	  | ok a => exact h a rfl

705	  theorem size_evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : ∀ t : Term, (evalTAll c t).size = c.n
706	    | .lit _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
707	    | .param _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
708	    | .measure _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; split <;> simp [size_constE, SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
709	    | .quantity _ args ps => by
710	        rw [evalTAll]; apply size_liftQ; intro a h
711	        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
712	          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
713	        exact Primitives.size_evalQ _ _ _ _ _ h

715	        rw [evalTAll]; split
716	        · exact size_constE _ _
717	        · rw [Primitives.size_distanceWhile]; exact size_evalAll c φ
718	    | .sinceRise φ => by rw [evalTAll, Temporal.size_sinceRiseAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
719	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => by
720	        rw [evalTAll]; split
721	        · exact size_constE _ _
722	        · apply size_liftQ; intro a h
723	          cases hg : stepOf g (evalTAll c g) <;> simp only [hg, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;>

726	    | .aggregate _ _ _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
727	    | .add a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
728	    | .sub a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
729	    | .mul a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
730	    | .div a b => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]

732	    | .abs a => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_map]; exact size_evalTAll c a
733	    | .cond _ _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp

737	    | .tt => by rw [evalAll]; exact Temporal.size_const _ _
738	    | .ff => by rw [evalAll]; exact Temporal.size_const _ _
739	    | .atom name args ps => by
740	        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
741	        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
742	          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
743	        split at h
744	        · cases h; split
745	          · split
746	            · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
747	            · split
748	              · exact Temporal.size_const _ _

760	    | .and φ ψ => by

763	        · rw [Temporal.size_zipAnd, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
764	    | .or φ ψ => by
765	        rw [evalAll]; split
766	        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
767	        · rw [Temporal.size_zipOr, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
768	    | .implies φ ψ => by
769	        rw [evalAll]; split

771	        · rw [Temporal.size_zipImplies, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
772	    | .always φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_alwaysAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ

778	        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>

780	        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_holdsForAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
781	    | .within m d s φ => by

783	        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>

786	    | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => by

789	          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
790	        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_untilWithinAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
791	    | .atLast m d s ψ φ => by
792	        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
793	        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
794	          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
795	        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_atLastAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
796	    | .count edge sφ _ _ => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_map, Temporal.size_countEdgesAll]; exact size_evalAll c edge
797	    | .rises φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_risesAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
798	    | .definedWhen pre φ => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalAll c pre, size_evalAll c φ, Nat.min_self]
799	    | .derived _ args ps => by
800	        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
801	        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
802	          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
803	        exact Primitives.size_evalB _ _ _ _ _ h
804	    | .rule _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp_all [size_constU]
805	    | .ruleApplies _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp_all [size_constU]
806	    | .existsUser _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
807	    | .forallUser _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
808	    | .existsRegion _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
809	    | .forallRegion _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
810	    | .existsDevice _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _

827	  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.and, R.settle, Tri.and, R.f]

831	  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.implies, R.not, R.or, R.settle, Tri.not, Tri.or, R.t]

833	/-- A connective is the pointwise three-valued operation of its operands' arrays, whether or not
834	    its right operand was evaluated: where the left one settles it at every instant, both arrays
835	    have one value per observation and every pointwise value is the settled one. -/
836	theorem evalAll_and : evalAll c (.and φ ψ) = Array.zipWith R.and (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by
837	  rw [evalAll]; split
838	  · rename_i h
839	    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
840	    apply Array.ext
841	    · simp [size_evalAll]
842	    · intro i h1 h2
843	      simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_zipWith]
844	      rw [and_of_f _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
845	  · rfl

847	  rw [evalAll]; split
848	  · rename_i h

850	    apply Array.ext
851	    · simp [size_evalAll]
852	    · intro i h1 h2

854	      rw [or_of_t _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
855	  · rfl

862	    · intro i h1 h2

864	      rw [implies_of_f _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]

868	theorem evalAll_until : evalAll c (.until φ ψ) = untilAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by rw [evalAll]
869	theorem evalAll_since : evalAll c (.since φ ψ) = sinceAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by rw [evalAll]
870	theorem evalAll_rule (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) (h : (c.compose id map c.β false).size = c.n) :
871	    evalAll c (.rule id map) = c.compose id map c.β false := by rw [evalAll]; simp [h]
872	theorem evalAll_ruleApplies (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) (h : (c.compose id map c.β true).size = c.n) :
873	    evalAll c (.ruleApplies id map) = c.compose id map c.β true := by rw [evalAll]; simp [h]
874	
875	/-- The heading-change term is the accumulation operator over its onset's values. -/
876	theorem evalTAll_headingSince (s : String) (g : Term) (x : TrackId) (gv : Q)

878	    evalTAll c (.headingSince s g ψ) = Primitives.headingSince c.d x gv (evalAll c ψ) := by

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
  The meaning of a formula over a trace: one three-valued result with reasons per instant.

  `evalAll` evaluates a formula bottom-up, each subformula once for the whole trace, so a formula
  costs O(|φ| · n log n) per binding: atoms map a scene function over the instants, the temporal
  operators are the single-pass operators of Temporal.lean, quantifiers evaluate their body once
  per region or device present anywhere in the trace. `eval c i φ` is the value at instant i.

  Atoms and derived concepts are dispatched by name to the definitions of Atoms.lean and
  Primitives.lean; a name the tables do not know, a wrong arity, a literal that spells no
  enumeration value or a variable of the wrong sort is `unknown (malformed …)`. The static check
  (RuleEval.check) finds every such defect from the syntax before any trace is read, so a checked
  rule reports at evaluation time only source absence, truncation, sampling gaps, undefined
  concept preconditions, division by zero and unknown compositions.

  Finite-trace policy — unobserved is unknown, never compliance:
  - `holdsFor` needs its whole window observed at adequate density, else unknown;
  - `within`/`untilWithin` are true on a witness, false only when the window is covered;
  - `eventually`/`until` carry the unobserved future, `since` the unobserved past, and `always`
    the unobserved future as unknown: on a finite trace `always φ` is false or unknown, never true.
    A rule's obligation is written for an instant; the sweep over instants (Grounding) is the
    "always".

  Rule composition is a callback, because the library of rules is defined above this file.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Primitives
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Intentions

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Semantics

open Primitives (DArg)
open Temporal

/-- Everything an evaluation needs: the indexed trace with its reading, the bindings, and how to
    evaluate another rule's obligation (`rule id map`) under a variable map, per instant. -/
structure SemCtx where
  d : Primitives.Ctx
  β : Binding := {}
  /-- Another rule's verdict per instant under a variable map: complied-with when `engaged` is
      false, engaged (classes and applicability) when true. -/
  compose : String → List (String × String) → Binding → Bool → Array R :=
    fun _ _ _ _ => #[]

namespace SemCtx
def n (c : SemCtx) : Nat := c.d.n
def scenes (c : SemCtx) : Array Scene := c.d.scenes
def bindVar (c : SemCtx) (v : String) (x : Val) : SemCtx := { c with β := c.β.bind v x }
def mk' (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (β : Binding := {}) : SemCtx := { d := Primitives.Ctx.mk' τ ρ, β := β }
end SemCtx

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Arguments
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def resolve (β : Binding) : Arg → Except UnknownReason DArg
  | .var v =>
    match β.lookup v with
    | some (.track t) => .ok (.v t)
    | some (.region r) => .ok (.v r)
    | some (.device d) => .ok (.v d)
    | none => .error (.unboundVariable v)
  | .lit s => .ok (.s s)
  | .nat k => .ok (.n k)

def resolveAll (β : Binding) (args : List Arg) : Except UnknownReason (List DArg) := args.mapM (resolve β)

private def ent (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason Nat :=
  match a with | .v t => .ok t | .n k => .ok k | .s _ => .error (.malformed "entity expected")
private def lit (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason String :=
  match a with | .s s => .ok s | _ => .error (.malformed "literal expected")
private def enumLit {α : Type} (ofString : String → Option α) (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason α := do
  let s ← lit a
  match ofString s with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.malformed s)

private def b (o : Option Bool) (name : String) : R := R.ofOption o (.absentAtom name)
private def eqEnum {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (o : Option α) (v : α) (name : String) : R :=
  b (o.map (· == v)) name
private def q (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
private def qn (o : Option Nat) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat v)) | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
private def qz (o : Option Int) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok (Q.ofInt v) | none => .error (.absentAtom name)

def unknownAtom (n : String) : UnknownReason := .malformed s!"atom {n}"
def arity (n : String) : UnknownReason := .malformed s!"arity {n}"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Boolean atoms by name, on one scene. Class atoms (`ru_*`, `st_*`, `dev_*` kinds) are dispatched
-- through the generated codecs, so the table cannot drift from ATOMS.md; attribute atoms are listed.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def evalAtomE (s : Scene) (name : String) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) : Except UnknownReason R := do
  match name, args with
  -- road users
  | "ru_subject", [x] => pure (b (ru_subject s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_aggregate", [_, .s w] => .error (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{w}")   -- resolved with the reading in `evalAll`
  | "ru_rider_posture", [x, f] =>
    match f with
    | .s "on_seat" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_on_seat s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "standing_on_deck" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "holding_another_vehicle" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "stunt" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_stunt s (← ent x)) name)
    | _ => .error (.malformed "posture field")
  | "ru_rider_posture_on_seat", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_on_seat s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_stunt", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_stunt s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_emergency_vehicle_kind", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (ru_emergency_vehicle_kind s (← ent x)) (← enumLit EmergencyKind.ofString k) name)
  | "ru_official_vehicle_kind", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (ru_official_vehicle_kind s (← ent x)) (← enumLit OfficialKind.ofString k) name)
  -- control state
  | "kin_engine_running", [x] => pure (b (kin_engine_running s (← ent x)) name)
  | "kin_parking_brake", [x] => pure (b (kin_parking_brake s (← ent x)) name)
  -- structure attributes

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Measured atoms by name (quantity-valued), on one scene. Vector atoms take a component literal.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def comp (v : Option Vec) (k : DArg) (name : String) : QR := do
  match k with
  | .s "x" => q (v.map (·.1)) name
  | .s "y" => q (v.map (·.2)) name
  | _ => .error (.malformed "component")

def evalMeasure (s : Scene) (name : String) (args : List DArg) : QR := do
  match name, args with
  | "kin_time", [] => .ok (Time.ofTimestamp (kin_time s))
  | "kin_position", [x, k] => comp (kin_position s (← ent x)) k name
  | "kin_heading", [x, k] => comp ((kin_heading s (← ent x)).bind Geom.unit) k name
  | "kin_velocity", [x, k] => comp (kin_velocity s (← ent x)) k name
  | "kin_speed", [x] => q (kin_speed s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_accel_longitudinal", [x] => q (kin_accel_longitudinal s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_yaw_rate", [x] => q (kin_yaw_rate s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_extent", [x, k] =>
    let e := kin_extent s (← ent x)
    match k with   -- full extents: twice the half-extent
    | .s "length" => q (e.map fun (l, _, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) l) name
    | .s "width" => q (e.map fun (_, w, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) w) name
    | .s "height" => q (e.map fun (_, _, h) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) h) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "extent")
  | "kin_steer_angle", [x] => q (kin_steer_angle s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_path_length", [x] => q (kin_path_length s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_gear", [x] => qz (kin_gear s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_throttle", [x] => q (kin_throttle s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_service_brake", [x] => q (kin_service_brake s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_occupant_count", [x] => qn (ru_occupant_count s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_rider_posture_hands_on_controls", [x] => qn (ru_rider_posture_hands_on_controls s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_electric_bicycle_class", [x] => qn (ru_electric_bicycle_class s (← ent x)) name
  | "st_lane_direction", [r, k] => comp ((st_lane_direction s (← ent r)).bind Geom.unit) k name
  | "st_lane_adjacency", [r, k] =>
    match k with
    | .s "ordinal" => qn (st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s (← ent r)) name
    | .s "count" => qn (st_lane_adjacency_count s (← ent r)) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "adjacency field")
  | "st_lane_adjacency_ordinal", [r] => qn (st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_lane_adjacency_count", [r] => qn (st_lane_adjacency_count s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_lane_width", [r] => q (st_lane_width s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_curvature", [r] => q (st_curvature s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_grade", [r] => q (st_grade s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_sight_distance", [r] => q (st_sight_distance s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_sight_along_way", [x, w] => q (st_sight_along_way s (← ent x) (← ent w)) name
  | "st_parking_space_angle", [r] => q (st_parking_space_angle s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_region_geometry", [r, k] => comp (st_region_geometry_position s (← ent r)) k name
  | "st_region_geometry_distance", [x, r] => q (st_region_geometry_distance s (← ent x) (← ent r)) name
  | "dev_position", [d, k] => comp (dev_position s (← ent d)) k name
  | "dev_speed_limit_sign_value", [d] => q (dev_speed_limit_sign_value s (← ent d)) name
  | "env_visibility", [] => q (env_visibility s) name
  | "env_civil_time", [k] =>
    let ct := env_civil_time s
    match k with
    | .s "minute_of_day" => qn (ct.map (·.minuteOfDay)) name
    | .s "weekday" => qn (ct.map (·.weekday)) name
    | .s "month" => qn (ct.map (·.month)) name
    | .s "day" => qn (ct.map (·.day)) name
    | .s "year" => qn (ct.map (·.year)) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "civil time field")
  | "rel_centre_distance", [a, a'] => q (rel_centre_distance s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
  | "rel_surface_gap", [a, a'] => q (rel_surface_gap_distance s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
  | "rel_surface_gap", [a, a', k] =>
    match k with
    | .s "longitudinal" => q (rel_surface_gap_longitudinal s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
    | .s "lateral" => q (rel_surface_gap_lateral s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "gap component")
  | "rel_longitudinal_overlap", [a, a'] => q (rel_longitudinal_overlap s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
  | "rel_bearing", [a, a', k] => comp (rel_bearing s (← ent a) (← ent a')) k name
  | n, _ => if measureNames.contains n then .error (arity n) else .error (unknownAtom n)

    "st_sight_distance", "st_sight_along_way", "st_parking_space_angle", "st_region_geometry", "st_region_geometry_distance",

/-- Whether a name is known to either table (the doctor holds this against `atomIds`). -/
def knowsAtom (n : String) : Bool :=
  let s : Scene := { t := 0 }
  let isUnknown : Except UnknownReason R → Bool
    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
    | _ => false
  let isUnknownQ : QR → Bool
    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
    | _ => false
  !(isUnknown (evalAtomE s n [] []) && isUnknownQ (evalMeasure s n []))

/-- The sort each entity argument of an atom must have (`none` marks a literal position): by
    family, with the mixed atoms listed. `none` for a name the tables do not know. -/
def atomArgSorts (name : String) : Option (List (Option EntityKind)) :=
  let t := some EntityKind.track; let r := some EntityKind.region; let d := some EntityKind.device
  match name with
  | "rel_occupies" => some [t, r]
  | "ru_aggregate" => some [t, none]
  | "dev_governs" => some [d, r]
  | "st_region_geometry_distance" | "st_sight_along_way" => some [t, r]
  | "st_lane_adjacency" => some [r, none, r]
  | "st_lane_adjacency_left" | "st_lane_adjacency_right" | "st_lane_connectivity" | "st_lane_enters" | "st_on_way"
  | "st_entrance_of" => some [r, r]
  | "st_lane_marking" => some [r, none, none, none]
  | "rel_oncoming" | "rel_same_direction" | "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" | "rel_ahead_in_lane"
  | "rel_behind_in_lane" | "rel_contact" | "rel_visible" | "rel_centre_distance" | "rel_longitudinal_overlap" => some [t, t]
  | "rel_surface_gap" | "rel_bearing" => some [t, t, none]
  | n =>
    if !knowsAtom n then none
    else if n.startsWith "env_" || n == "kin_time" then some []
    else if n.startsWith "ru_" || n.startsWith "kin_" || n.startsWith "sig_" then some [t, none, none]
    else if n.startsWith "st_" then some [r, none, none]
    else if n.startsWith "dev_" then some [d, none, none]
    else none

/-- The Lean name of an ATOMS.md id or attribute path (`dev.traffic_signal.shows` ↦ `dev_traffic_signal_shows`). -/
def defName (id : String) : String := id.replace "." "_"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The evaluator: every subformula once, over the whole trace.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array R := const n (R.u w)
def constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array QR := Array.replicate n (.error w)
def liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R)) : Array R :=
  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constU n w
def liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR)) : Array QR :=
  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constE n w
def qzip (f : Q → Q → Q) (a b : Array QR) : Array QR :=
  Array.zipWith (fun x y => do pure (f (← x) (← y))) a b

/-- A term that names no instant: a literal, a parameter or arithmetic over those. Only such a
    term may parametrize an atom or a derived concept. -/
partial def Term.isConstant : Term → Bool
  | .lit _ _ | .param _ => true
  | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => Term.isConstant a && Term.isConstant b
  | .neg a | .abs a => Term.isConstant a
  | _ => false

/-- The single value of a constant term's per-instant array. -/
def constOf (t : Term) (arr : Array QR) : Except UnknownReason Q := do
  if !Term.isConstant t then throw (.malformed "parameter is not a constant term")
  arr[0]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)

/-- The value of a heading change's step bound: a literal or a reading parameter, read as `constOf`
    reads a constant; any other term is malformed. -/
def stepOf (t : Term) (arr : Array QR) : Except UnknownReason Q :=
  match t with
  | .lit _ _ | .param _ => arr[0]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)
  | _ => .error (.malformed "heading_since step bound is not a literal or a reading parameter")

/-- The subject variable of a window: needed for path windows, irrelevant for time windows. -/
def subjectFor (β : Binding) (m : Measure) (v : String) : Except UnknownReason TrackId :=
  match m with
  | .time => .ok 0
  | .path => match β.track v with | some t => .ok t | none => .error (.unboundVariable v)

/-- Every region a quantifier over a kind ranges over in some scene of the trace: those whose
    membership of the kind is not false there (`regionCandidates`). -/
def regionsOf (c : SemCtx) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap fun s => regionCandidates s k).eraseDups
def devicesOf (c : SemCtx) (k : DeviceKind) : List DeviceId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap fun s => deviceCandidates s k).eraseDups
/-- At each instant, whether the region is of the kind: true, false, or unknown where the source
    cannot tell the kind. A quantifier conjoins it with its body, so a region the source cannot
    place in the kind makes the quantifier unknown, never decided by its absence. -/
def regionIsKind (c : SemCtx) (r : RegionId) (k : StructureKind) : Array R :=
  c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (isKind s r k) (.absentAtom s!"st_{k}")
def deviceIsKind (c : SemCtx) (d : DeviceId) (k : DeviceKind) : Array R :=
  c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (devKind s d k) (.absentAtom s!"dev_{k}")
/-- Every road user present in some scene of the trace. -/
def usersOf (c : SemCtx) : List TrackId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups

/-- The kind a quantifier ranges over: a spelling of the ontology. A variable here is a concept's
    literal formal that no expansion filled. -/
def regionKindOf (a : Arg) : Except UnknownReason StructureKind :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => match StructureKind.ofString s with | some k => .ok k | none => .error (.malformed s!"region kind {s}")
  | .var v => .error (.malformed s!"region kind `{v}` is a variable")
  | .nat _ => .error (.malformed "region kind")
def deviceKindOf (a : Arg) : Except UnknownReason DeviceKind :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => match DeviceKind.ofString s with | some k => .ok k | none => .error (.malformed s!"device kind {s}")
  | .var v => .error (.malformed s!"device kind `{v}` is a variable")
  | .nat _ => .error (.malformed "device kind")

/-- φ where the precondition holds; undefined where it is false; the precondition's reasons where
    it is unknown. -/
def definedWhenR (pre x : R) : R :=
  match pre.v with
  | .t => x
  | .f => R.u (.undefined "defined_when")
  | .u => ⟨.u, pre.why⟩

/-- A selection at one instant: the branch the guard picks; where the guard is unknown, the
    branches' common value, else unknown with the guard's reasons. -/
def condAt (g : R) (a b : QR) : QR :=
  match g.v with
  | .t => a
  | .f => b
  | .u => match a, b with
    | .ok x, .ok y => if Q.eq x y then .ok x else .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))
    | _, _ => .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))

/-- An aggregate over the members present at one instant: unknown when a member's membership is
    unknown or a member's value is; `count` on an empty set is zero, the others are undefined. -/
def aggregateAt (op : AggOp) (xs : List (R × QR)) : QR :=
  match xs.find? (fun (f, _) => f.v == .u) with
  | some (f, _) => .error (f.why.head?.getD (.malformed "aggregate"))
  | none =>
    let vals := xs.filterMap fun (f, q) => if f.v == .t then some q else none
    match op with
    | .count => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat vals.length))
    | _ => do
      let qs ← vals.mapM fun q => q
      if qs.isEmpty then .error (.undefined "aggregate")
      else
        let sorted := qs.toArray.qsort (fun a b => Q.lt a b)
        match op with
        | .min => .ok sorted[0]!
        | .max => .ok sorted[sorted.size - 1]!
        | _ => .ok sorted[sorted.size / 2]!

/-- Membership of a road user in a legal aggregate at one scene: true when it carries an included
    class; unknown, with the observation's reason, when an included or unresolved class it might
    carry is unobserved; unknown as `aggregateUnresolved` when it carries a class the definition
    leaves unresolved; false otherwise. -/
def aggregateMembership (s : Scene) (t : TrackId) (a : LegalAggregate) : R :=
  let classes := fun (ids : List String) => ids.filterMap fun i => RoadUserClass.ofString (i.drop 3).toString
  match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.included) with
  | some true => R.t
  | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")
  | some false =>
    match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.unresolved) with
    | some true => R.u (.aggregateUnresolved a.id)
    | some false => R.f
    | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")

/-- Kleene aggregate at each instant over the evaluated members present in that scene. -/
def perScene (c : SemCtx) (evaluated : List (Nat × Array R))
    (presentIn : Scene → Nat → Bool) (agg : List R → R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
    let s := c.scenes[i]!
    agg (evaluated.filterMap fun (m, arr) => if presentIn s m then some arr[i]! else none)

mutual
  def evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : Term → Array QR
    | .lit v _ => Array.replicate c.n (.ok v)
    | .param p => Array.replicate c.n (match c.d.ρ.param p with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.parameterMissing p))
    | .measure a args =>
      match resolveAll c.β args with
      | .error w => constE c.n w
      | .ok ds => c.scenes.map fun s => evalMeasure s a ds
    | .quantity concept args ps =>
      liftQ c.n do
        let vs ← constParams c ps
        Primitives.evalQ concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
    | .distanceWhile subj φ =>
      match c.β.track subj with
      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
      | some x => Primitives.distanceWhile c.d x (evalAll c φ)
    | .sinceRise φ => sinceRiseAll c.d.times (evalAll c φ)
    | .headingSince subj g ψ =>
      match c.β.track subj with
      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
      | some x => liftQ c.n do
          let gv ← stepOf g (evalTAll c g)
          pure (Primitives.headingSince c.d x gv (evalAll c ψ))
    | .aggregate op v φ t =>
      let members := (usersOf c).map fun u =>
        let c' := c.bindVar v (.track u)
        (u, evalAll c' φ, evalTAll c' t)
      (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
        let s := c.scenes[i]!
        aggregateAt op (members.filterMap fun (u, fa, ta) => if s.tracks.contains u then some (fa[i]!, ta[i]!) else none)
    | .add a b' => qzip Q.add (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .sub a b' => qzip Q.sub (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .mul a b' => qzip Q.mul (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .div a b' => Array.zipWith (fun x y => do
        let d ← y
        if Q.isZero d then .error (.divisionByZero "div") else pure (Q.div (← x) d)) (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .neg a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.neg)
    | .abs a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.abs)
    | .cond φ a b' =>
      let g := evalAll c φ; let x := evalTAll c a; let y := evalTAll c b'
      (Array.range c.n).map fun i => condAt (g[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)) (x[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)) (y[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange))
  termination_by t => sizeOf t

  /-- Parameters of an atom or derived concept: constant terms, evaluated once. -/
  def constParams (c : SemCtx) : List Term → Except UnknownReason (List Q)
    | [] => .ok []
    | t :: rest => do
      let v ← constOf t (evalTAll c t)
      pure (v :: (← constParams c rest))
  termination_by ts => sizeOf ts

  def evalAll (c : SemCtx) : Formula → Array R
    | .tt => const c.n R.t
    | .ff => const c.n R.f
    | .atom name args ps =>
      liftA c.n do
        let vs ← constParams c ps
        let ds ← resolveAll c.β args
        if name == "ru_aggregate" then
          pure (match ds with
            | [.v t, .s id] =>
              match c.d.aggregateOverrides.find? (fun (x, a, _) => x == t && a == id) with
              | some (_, _, v) => const c.n (R.ofBool v)
              | none =>
                match c.d.ρ.aggregate id with
                | none => const c.n (R.u (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{id}"))
                | some a => c.scenes.map fun s => aggregateMembership s t a
            | _ => const c.n (R.u (.malformed "aggregate arguments")))
        else pure (c.scenes.map fun s => match evalAtomE s name ds vs with | .ok r => r | .error w => R.u w)
    | .cmp l op r => Array.zipWith (fun x y => match x, y with
        | .ok a, .ok b => R.ofBool (op.apply a b)
        | .error w, _ | _, .error w => R.u w) (evalTAll c l) (evalTAll c r)
    | .asm id => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.assumption id) (.assumptionMissing id)
    | .intent id who target =>
      match who, target with
      | .var a, .var b =>
        match c.β.lookup a, c.β.lookup b with
        | some (.track x), some (.region r) => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.intention id x r) (.intentionMissing id)
        | none, _ => constU c.n (.unboundVariable a)
        | _, none => constU c.n (.unboundVariable b)
        | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
    | .same a b =>
      match resolve c.β a, resolve c.β b with
      | .ok (.v i), .ok (.v j) => const c.n (R.ofBool (i == j))
      | .error w, _ | _, .error w => constU c.n w
      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "same: entities expected")
    | .not φ => mapNot (evalAll c φ)
    -- a connective whose left operand settles it at every instant does not evaluate its right one
    | .and φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.f) else zipAnd a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .or φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .t) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipOr a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .implies φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipImplies a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .always φ => alwaysAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .eventually φ => eventuallyAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .until φ ψ => untilAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
    | .since φ ψ => sinceAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
    | .holdsFor m d subj φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (holdsForAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "holdsFor" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
    | .within m d subj φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (withinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "within" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (untilWithinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "untilWithin" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ))
    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (atLastAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "atLast" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c ψ) (evalAll c φ))
    | .count edge sinceφ op k =>
      (countEdgesAll "count" (evalAll c edge) (evalAll c sinceφ)).map fun e => match e with
        | .error w => R.u w
        | .ok m => R.ofBool (op.apply (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat m)) (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)))
    | .rises φ => risesAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .definedWhen pre φ => Array.zipWith definedWhenR (evalAll c pre) (evalAll c φ)
    | .derived concept args ps =>
      liftA c.n do
        let vs ← constParams c ps
        Primitives.evalB concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
    | .rule id map =>
      let arr := c.compose id map c.β false
      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
    | .ruleApplies id map =>
      let arr := c.compose id map c.β true
      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
    | .existsUser v φ =>
      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.any
    | .forallUser v φ =>
      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.all
    | .existsRegion k v φ =>
      match regionKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
            (r, Array.zipWith R.and (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.any
    | .forallRegion k v φ =>
      match regionKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
            (r, Array.zipWith R.implies (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.all
    | .existsDevice k v φ =>
      match deviceKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
            (d, Array.zipWith R.and (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.any
    | .forallDevice k v φ =>
      match deviceKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
            (d, Array.zipWith R.implies (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.all
  termination_by φ => sizeOf φ
end

/-- The value of a formula at instant `i`. -/
def eval (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : R := (evalAll c φ)[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)
def evalTri (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : Tri := (eval c i φ).v

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lengths: every formula and every term has exactly one value per observation of the trace.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Lengths

private theorem n_bindVar (c : SemCtx) (v : String) (x : Val) : (c.bindVar v x).n = c.n := rfl
private theorem size_constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : (constU n w).size = n := by
  simp [constU, Temporal.size_const]
private theorem size_constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : (constE n w).size = n := by simp [constE]
private theorem size_liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R))
    (h : ∀ a, e = .ok a → a.size = n) : (liftA n e).size = n := by
  unfold liftA; cases e with
  | ok a => exact h a rfl
  | error w => exact size_constU n w
private theorem size_liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR))
    (h : ∀ a, e = .ok a → a.size = n) : (liftQ n e).size = n := by
  unfold liftQ; cases e with
  | ok a => exact h a rfl
  | error w => exact size_constE n w
private theorem size_qzip (f : Q → Q → Q) (a b : Array QR) : (qzip f a b).size = min a.size b.size := by
  simp [qzip]
private theorem size_perScene (c : SemCtx) (ev : List (Nat × Array R)) (p : Scene → Nat → Bool)
    (agg : List R → R) : (perScene c ev p agg).size = c.n := by simp [perScene]

mutual
  theorem size_evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : ∀ t : Term, (evalTAll c t).size = c.n
    | .lit _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
    | .param _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
    | .measure _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; split <;> simp [size_constE, SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .quantity _ args ps => by
        rw [evalTAll]; apply size_liftQ; intro a h
        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
        exact Primitives.size_evalQ _ _ _ _ _ h
    | .distanceWhile s φ => by
        rw [evalTAll]; split
        · exact size_constE _ _
        · rw [Primitives.size_distanceWhile]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .sinceRise φ => by rw [evalTAll, Temporal.size_sinceRiseAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => by
        rw [evalTAll]; split
        · exact size_constE _ _
        · apply size_liftQ; intro a h
          cases hg : stepOf g (evalTAll c g) <;> simp only [hg, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;>
            try contradiction
          cases h; rw [Primitives.size_headingSince]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
    | .add a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .sub a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .mul a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .div a b => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .neg a => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_map]; exact size_evalTAll c a
    | .abs a => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_map]; exact size_evalTAll c a
    | .cond _ _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
  termination_by t => sizeOf t

  theorem size_evalAll (c : SemCtx) : ∀ φ : Formula, (evalAll c φ).size = c.n
    | .tt => by rw [evalAll]; exact Temporal.size_const _ _
    | .ff => by rw [evalAll]; exact Temporal.size_const _ _
    | .atom name args ps => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
        split at h
        · cases h; split
          · split
            · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
            · split
              · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
              · simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
          · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
        · cases h; simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .cmp l _ r => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalTAll c l, size_evalTAll c r, Nat.min_self]
    | .asm _ => by rw [evalAll]; simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .intent _ who target => by
        cases who <;> cases target <;> rw [evalAll] <;> (repeat' split) <;>
          simp [size_constU, SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .same a b => by
        rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp [size_constU, Temporal.size_const]
    | .not φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_mapNot]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .and φ ψ => by
        rw [evalAll]; split
        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
        · rw [Temporal.size_zipAnd, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
    | .or φ ψ => by
        rw [evalAll]; split
        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
        · rw [Temporal.size_zipOr, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
    | .implies φ ψ => by
        rw [evalAll]; split
        · rw [Array.size_map]; exact size_evalAll c φ
        · rw [Temporal.size_zipImplies, size_evalAll c φ, size_evalAll c ψ, Nat.min_self]
    | .always φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_alwaysAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .eventually φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_eventuallyAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .until φ ψ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_untilAll]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
    | .since φ ψ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_sinceAll]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
    | .holdsFor m d s φ => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_holdsForAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .within m d s φ => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_withinAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_untilWithinAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .atLast m d s ψ φ => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hx : subjectFor c.β m s <;> cases hd : constOf d (evalTAll c d) <;>
          simp only [hx, hd, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;> try contradiction
        cases h; rw [Temporal.size_atLastAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .count edge sφ _ _ => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_map, Temporal.size_countEdgesAll]; exact size_evalAll c edge
    | .rises φ => by rw [evalAll, Temporal.size_risesAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .definedWhen pre φ => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalAll c pre, size_evalAll c φ, Nat.min_self]
    | .derived _ args ps => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
        exact Primitives.size_evalB _ _ _ _ _ h
    | .rule _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp_all [size_constU]
    | .ruleApplies _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split <;> simp_all [size_constU]
    | .existsUser _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .forallUser _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .existsRegion _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .forallRegion _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .existsDevice _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
    | .forallDevice _ _ _ => by rw [evalAll]; split; exact size_constU _ _; exact size_perScene _ _ _ _
  termination_by φ => sizeOf φ
end

end Lengths

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Unfolding lemmas: the connectives are the pointwise three-valued operations of Unknown.lean.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Lemmas
variable (c : SemCtx) (φ ψ : Formula)

theorem evalAll_tt : evalAll c .tt = const c.n R.t := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_ff : evalAll c .ff = const c.n R.f := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_not : evalAll c (.not φ) = (evalAll c φ).map R.not := by rw [evalAll]; rfl

  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.and, R.settle, Tri.and, R.f]

  rw [evalAll]; split
  · rename_i h
    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
    apply Array.ext
    · simp [size_evalAll]
    · intro i h1 h2

  · rfl

  rw [evalAll]; split

22	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World

24	
25	namespace TrafficSpec
26	
27	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
28	-- Geometry helpers for the `rel_*` atoms (exact rationals; the one square root is an integer
29	-- square root at micrometre resolution).
30	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
31	namespace Geom
32	def vsub (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.sub a.1 b.1, Q.sub a.2 b.2)
33	def vadd (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.add a.1 b.1, Q.add a.2 b.2)
34	def dot (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.add (Q.mul a.1 b.1) (Q.mul a.2 b.2)
35	/-- 2-D cross product `a × b`; positive when `b` is to the left of `a`. -/
36	def cross (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.sub (Q.mul a.1 b.2) (Q.mul a.2 b.1)
37	def normSq (a : Vec) : Q := dot a a
38	/-- Square root of a non-negative quantity in metres, floored to micrometres. -/
39	def sqrtMicro (q : Q) : Q :=
40	  if q.num ≤ 0 then Q.zero
41	  else
42	    let scaled : Int := (q.num * 1000000000000) / (q.den : Int)   -- µm²
43	    Units.micrometres (Int.ofNat (isqrt scaled.toNat))
44	def norm (a : Vec) : Q := sqrtMicro (normSq a)
45	/-- The unit vector along `a`; `none` for the zero vector only. `a` is first divided by its larger
46	    absolute component, so the vector normalised has length between 1 and √2 whatever `a`'s scale,
47	    and then by that length taken to micrometres (`norm`). The result is the exact unit vector times
48	    a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶, and is exact where the scaled length is a whole
49	    number of micrometres (every axis-aligned direction). -/
50	def unit (a : Vec) : Option Vec :=
51	  let m := Q.max (Q.abs a.1) (Q.abs a.2)
52	  if Q.isZero m then none
53	  else
54	    let b := (Q.div a.1 m, Q.div a.2 m)
55	    let n := norm b
56	    some (Q.div b.1 n, Q.div b.2 n)

58	    `h` is read as a direction (`unit`), whatever its length; `v` keeps its own. -/
59	def inFrame (h v : Vec) : Option (Q × Q) := do
60	  let u ← unit h
61	  pure (dot u v, cross u v)
62	/-- Distance from a point to a segment. -/
63	def segmentDistance (p a b : Vec) : Q :=
64	  let ab := vsub b a
65	  let ap := vsub p a
66	  let l2 := normSq ab
67	  if Q.isZero l2 then norm ap
68	  else
69	    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot ap ab) l2))

72	def inPolygon (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
73	  let n := poly.length
74	  if n < 3 then false
75	  else
76	    let edges := (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
77	    let crossings := edges.filter fun (a, b) =>
78	      let (ax, ay) := a; let (bx, by_) := b
79	      ((Q.le ay p.2) != (Q.le by_ p.2)) &&
80	        -- x-intersection of the edge with the horizontal line through p, compared with p.x
81	        (let dy := Q.sub by_ ay
82	         !Q.isZero dy &&
83	         Q.lt p.1 (Q.add ax (Q.div (Q.mul (Q.sub p.2 ay) (Q.sub bx ax)) dy)))
84	    crossings.length % 2 == 1
85	/-- The sign of `(b − a) × (c − a)`: 1 when `c` is to the left of `ab`, −1 to its right, 0 on its line. -/
86	def orient (a b c : Vec) : Int :=
87	  let k := (cross (vsub b a) (vsub c a)).num
88	  if k > 0 then 1 else if k < 0 then -1 else 0
89	/-- Whether `p` lies on the closed segment `ab`, given that it lies on its line. -/
90	def withinBox (p a b : Vec) : Bool :=
91	  Q.le (Q.min a.1 b.1) p.1 && Q.le p.1 (Q.max a.1 b.1) && Q.le (Q.min a.2 b.2) p.2 && Q.le p.2 (Q.max a.2 b.2)
92	/-- Whether the closed segments `ab` and `cd` share a point, touching and collinear overlap included. -/
93	def segmentsIntersect (a b c d : Vec) : Bool :=
94	  let o1 := orient a b c; let o2 := orient a b d; let o3 := orient c d a; let o4 := orient c d b
95	  (o1 * o2 < 0 && o3 * o4 < 0) || (o1 == 0 && withinBox c a b) || (o2 == 0 && withinBox d a b)
96	    || (o3 == 0 && withinBox a c d) || (o4 == 0 && withinBox b c d)
97	/-- The edges of a polygon, the last vertex closing to the first. -/
98	def edges (poly : List Vec) : List (Vec × Vec) :=
99	  let n := poly.length
100	  (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
101	/-- Whether two polygons share a point as closed sets: an edge of one meets an edge of the other
102	    (touching counts), or one lies inside the other. Exact. -/
103	def polygonsOverlap (p q : List Vec) : Bool :=
104	  (edges p).any (fun (a, b) => (edges q).any fun (c, d) => segmentsIntersect a b c d)
105	    || p.any (inPolygon · q) || q.any (inPolygon · p)
106	/-- Distance from a point to a polygon's boundary: zero inside, the nearest edge outside. -/
107	def polygonDistance (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Q :=
108	  match poly with
109	  | [] => none
110	  | [a] => some (norm (vsub p a))
111	  | _ =>
112	    if inPolygon p poly then some Q.zero
113	    else
114	      let n := poly.length
115	      let ds := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentDistance p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
116	      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
117	/-- The point of a segment nearest a point. -/
118	def segmentNearest (p a b : Vec) : Vec :=
119	  let ab := vsub b a
120	  let l2 := normSq ab
121	  if Q.isZero l2 then a
122	  else
123	    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot (vsub p a) ab) l2))
124	    vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)
125	/-- The point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point. -/
126	def nearestPoint (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
127	  match poly with
128	  | [] => none
129	  | [a] => some a
130	  | _ =>
131	    let n := poly.length
132	    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
133	    cs.foldl (fun acc c => match acc with
134	      | none => some c
135	      | some b => if Q.lt (normSq (vsub p c)) (normSq (vsub p b)) then some c else some b) none
136	/-- Every point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point: the nearest point of each edge whose
137	    distance is the least, so a tie keeps every equally near point whatever the vertex order. -/
138	def nearestPoints (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Vec :=
139	  match poly with
140	  | [] => []
141	  | [a] => [a]
142	  | _ =>
143	    let n := poly.length
144	    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
145	    match cs.map fun c => normSq (vsub p c) with
146	    | [] => []
147	    | d :: ds =>
148	      let m := ds.foldl Q.min d
149	      cs.filter fun c => Q.eq (normSq (vsub p c)) m
150	/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when
151	    they share a point (`polygonsOverlap`), otherwise the shortest vector joining a vertex of one to
152	    the nearest point of the other's boundary, which for two convex polygons is the same for every
153	    nearest pair. `none` for an empty polygon. -/
154	def nearestOffset (p q : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
155	  if polygonsOverlap p q then some (Q.zero, Q.zero)
156	  else
157	    let fromP := p.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c q).map (vsub · c)
158	    let fromQ := q.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c p).map (vsub c ·)
159	    (fromP ++ fromQ).foldl (fun acc d => match acc with
160	      | none => some d
161	      | some e => if Q.lt (normSq d) (normSq e) then some d else some e) none
162	/-- The interval a polygon covers along the direction `u`, measured from `o`: (lowest, highest). -/
163	def span (u o : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option (Q × Q) :=
164	  match poly.map fun c => dot u (vsub c o) with
165	  | [] => none
166	  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldl Q.min x, xs.foldl Q.max x)
167	/-- Twice the signed area of a polygon (the shoelace sum). -/
168	def area2 (poly : List Vec) : Q :=
169	  (edges poly).foldl (fun acc (a, b) => Q.add acc (cross a b)) Q.zero
170	/-- Whether a polygon's boundary crosses or touches itself: two edges that are not neighbours
171	    meet, or two neighbouring edges fold back along one line. -/
172	def selfIntersects (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
173	  let es := (edges poly).toArray
174	  let n := es.size
175	  (List.range n).any fun i => (List.range n).any fun j =>
176	    if j ≤ i then false
177	    else
178	      let (a, b) := es[i]!
179	      let (c, d) := es[j]!
180	      if j == i + 1 then orient a b d == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub b a) (vsub d c)) Q.zero
181	      else if i == 0 && j + 1 == n then orient c d b == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub d c) (vsub b a)) Q.zero
182	      else segmentsIntersect a b c d
183	/-- A simple polygon: at least three vertices, a non-zero area, and a boundary that neither crosses
184	    nor touches itself (a repeated vertex makes two edges that are not neighbours meet). -/
185	def simplePolygon (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
186	  poly.length ≥ 3 && !Q.isZero (area2 poly) && !selfIntersects poly
187	/-- Whether a point lies on a polygon's boundary. Exact. -/
188	def onBoundary (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
189	  (edges poly).any fun (a, b) => orient a b p == 0 && withinBox p a b
190	/-- The parameters `t` at which the line `p + t·u` meets the polygon's boundary: one per edge it
191	    crosses or touches, and both ends of an edge it runs along. `u` is not the zero vector. -/
192	def lineCrossings (p u : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Q :=
193	  (edges poly).flatMap fun (a, b) =>
194	    let d := vsub b a
195	    let w := vsub a p
196	    let den := cross u d
197	    if Q.isZero den then
198	      if Q.isZero (cross u w) then [Q.div (dot w u) (dot u u), Q.div (dot (vsub b p) u) (dot u u)] else []
199	    else
200	      let s := Q.div (cross w u) den
201	      if Q.le Q.zero s && Q.le s (Q.ofInt 1) then [Q.div (cross w d) den] else []
202	end Geom

277	/-- Whether kind `a` refines kind `b`, reflexively and transitively. -/
278	def StructureKind.refines (a b : StructureKind) : Bool := a == b || a.ancestors.contains b
279	
280	/-- Whether a source that cannot tell kind `m` (it is among `unobservedKinds`) leaves this structure's
281	    membership of `m`'s kinds open: always where `m` refines no kind other than an abstract one;
282	    otherwise only where the structure is labelled `m` or a kind `m` refines, since a structure of any
283	    other kind is known not to be one. -/
284	def Structure.maskApplies (st : Structure) (m : StructureKind) : Bool :=
285	  (m.parent?.filter (!·.isAbstract)).isNone || m.refines st.kind
286	
287	/-- Whether a structure is of kind `k`: unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
288	    structure, is `k` or a kind `k` refines (the label cannot be trusted for `k`); true where the
289	    structure's kind refines `k`; unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
290	    structure, refines `k`; false otherwise. A parent never implies a kind refining it, two kinds
291	    refining one parent never imply each other, and a kind the source cannot tell never makes a known
292	    parent unknown. An abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it: true where the structure
293	    is of one of them, unknown where it is of none and unknown for one, false otherwise. -/
294	def Structure.isOfKind (st : Structure) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
295	  let masked := st.unobservedKinds.filter st.maskApplies
296	  let concrete (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
297	    if masked.any (k.refines ·) then none
298	    else if st.kind.refines k then some true
299	    else if masked.any (·.refines k) then none
300	    else some false
301	  if k.isAbstract then
302	    let vs := (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k)).map concrete
303	    if vs.contains (some true) then some true else if vs.contains none then none else some false
304	  else concrete k

402	/-- The rectangle a road user's body covers on the ground, from its position, heading and
403	    half-extents; `none` when one of them is not observed. -/
404	def footprint (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List Vec) := do
405	  let p ← kin_position s x
406	  let h ← kin_heading s x
407	  let (hl, hw, _) ← kin_extent s x
408	  let u ← Geom.unit h
409	  let v := (Q.neg u.2, u.1)
410	  let corner (a b : Q) : Vec := Geom.vadd p (Q.add (Q.mul a u.1) (Q.mul b v.1), Q.add (Q.mul a u.2) (Q.mul b v.2))
411	  pure [corner hl hw, corner hl (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) hw]

414	    boundary, otherwise the nearest approach between the two outlines. Without a footprint (no

418	  let p ← kin_position s x
419	  match st_region_geometry_boundary s r, footprint s x with
420	  | some poly, some fp =>

422	    else
423	      let ds := fp.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · poly) ++ poly.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · fp)

426	  | none, fp =>
427	    let c ← st_region_geometry_position s r
428	    match fp with
429	    | some poly => Geom.polygonDistance c poly
430	    | none => some (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub c p))

522	-- Environment
523	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
524	def env_darkness (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.darkness

528	def env_visibility (s : Scene) : Option Q := s.env.visibility
